purpose: Make the app look and read like the rest of the desktop in both themes and in a narrow pane.

questions.question: When it opens, what is the first thing on the screen?
Is it a table of rows, a few numbers, a short reading view, or one answer?
Is anything on this page good, warning or blocked, and what makes it so?
Who is this chat talking to, and what must it never say?
Does anything need to stay side by side when the window is narrow?
What should the row say, and what does it look like next to the others?

artifact: the Design row of APP.md; the design itself lands in the inline <style> of index.html, in surface.instructions, or in the row copy of a link

rules.rule: Colour, type and radius come only from the injected tokens. No hex, rgb() or hsl(). The seed's token list is generated from TOKEN_CSS at payload time, never hand-typed.
rules.enforced_by: server prepends the token sheet; C10; constants-parity test

rules.rule: Five panel tokens are not injected and resolve to nothing: --shadow, --bubble, --th-bg, --knob, --vld-tx.
rules.enforced_by: C10 names them in its failure text

rules.rule: The page never redefines the injected sheet: no :root, no html[data-theme], no #sutra-tokens selector. It must read in both themes.
rules.sutra_source: modules_api.py page_html theme handling; static/js/18-modules.js theme query

rules.rule: One h1 at most, then h2, h3 in order, never skipping a level. The h1 names the content view, not the app.

Contrast comes from the pairings that already pass 4.5:1: --ink on --bg/--surface/--card, --muted for secondary prose, --on-acc on --acc. --faint is for crumbs, column heads and pills, never body text.
rules.enforced_by: guidance; C10 covers the hard half

rules.rule: The page draws no chrome of its own: no repeated app name, no tagline, no crumb, no kind or status pill. The header above it already carries all of that.
rules.sutra_source: APPS-DESIGN.md header-only app view (D-M17); static/js/18-modules.js modAppViewHtml

rules.rule: No animation is added. A transition that genuinely helps is under 150ms and disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
The page survives a narrow pane: one column by default, no fixed width or min-width above 320px, no sideways scroll.
rules.sutra_source: APPS-DESIGN.md narrow pane; static/panel.css .dpage container query

rules.rule: Chat instructions are a visible first message: a role line, at most eight short standing rules, one closing ask, 4000 characters maximum.
A link has exactly one design decision, the row copy, and it borrows the screen it opens. The Design row of a link's record always reads that decision.
rules.sutra_source: static/js/18-modules.js link row and Open control
rules.enforced_by: C3 covers the row copy; C1 asserts the Design cell; C32 covers the target

checks.what: Every colour, font and radius value is var(--token), and every token named is one the server injects.
checks.evaluator: scan <style> blocks and style= attributes for colour/font/radius declarations with #rgb/#rrggbb/rgb(/hsl(/named colours outside a var() fallback; collect var(--name) and diff against the token set parsed from TOKEN_CSS; the five not-injected names are called out

checks.what: The page does not redefine the injected sheet.
checks.evaluator: FAIL on :root{, :root ,, html[data-theme, or #sutra-tokens used as a selector

checks.what: At most one h1, headings in order, no skipped level.
checks.evaluator: census of h1..h6 in document order; FAIL when h1 count > 1 or a heading exceeds the previous level by more than one

checks.what: The instructions read as a visible first message and fit the cap.
checks.evaluator: non-empty and len <= INSTR_MAX; first non-empty line ends in a full stop; at most eight lines beginning with a dash; last non-empty line contains ? or starts with Start by/Ask

checks.what: The page does not repeat the header drawn above it.
checks.evaluator: WARN when name or tagline appears as heading or first paragraph text in the first 400 characters

checks.what: No motion added, or motion disabled under reduced motion.
checks.evaluator: WARN when @keyframes, animation: or transition: appears and no prefers-reduced-motion block exists

checks.what: Reads in a narrow pane with no sideways scrolling.
checks.evaluator: WARN on min-width above 320px, a container width/max-width in px above 360, white-space: nowrap over a table, or overflow-x: scroll; a 320px render probe when C36's runtime ran
